text: In 1990s Oregon, FBI agent Lee Harker, who may be clairvoyant, is assigned to a string of murder-suicides in which [fathers kill their families and then themselves|threat|people who kill], leaving letters with Satanic glyphs signed Longlegs. Lee [decodes the letters|trigger|digging into a mystery] and finds that each family had a nine-year-old daughter born on the fourteenth, the dates forming [an occult triangle on the calendar|rules|it chooses who dies] with one date missing. When a coded birthday card arrives for Lee herself, she and her supervisor find a doll [with a metal orb inside its head|images|dolls, masks and likenesses].
